Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel is the campus chapel of St. Edward's University in Austin, Texas. The building, originally called Exhibition Hall, was constructed in the late 1890s as the university auditorium. Over the following decades, it served a series of functions. It was, at different points, a theater (known as the Abbey Theater), a classroom building, and a shooting range, before being consecrated as a chapel in or around 1947, under the name Our Lady of Victory Chapel. It was given its current name in 1973 and underwent a major renovation in 2014.
